statement: SDL_hidapi_ps4 defines four output-effect level bytes after eight reserved bytes, at effects offsets 15,16,17,18 for left, right, microphone, and speaker. Its normal effects code zero-initializes the struct and fills rumble and lightbar only; it does not populate these levels or send microphone samples. SDL's full USB report 0x05 places the effect block at offset 4 and its official BT report 0x11 at offset 6, with a CRC on BT. The kernel's common DS4 effects block does not corroborate SDL's level offsets.

applicability.scope: SDL layout evidence only; SDL full-report offsets of volume slots are USB 19-22 and official Bluetooth 21-24.
